1: # AttendEase LMS - Attendance Management System
2: 
3: A modern, web-based Learning Management System focused on attendance tracking, inspired by Google Classroom.
4: 
5: ![AttendEase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0-blue) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-17+-orange) ![Spring Boot](https://img.shields.io/badge/Spring%20Boot-3.2.5-green) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-blue)
6: 
7: ---
8: 
9: ## 📦 Available Versions
10: 
11: | Version | Tech Stack | Status |
12: |---------|------------|--------|
13: | **Modern (Recommended)** | Spring Boot 3.2 + React 19 + PostgreSQL | ✅ Active |
14: | **Legacy** | PHP 8.0 + MySQL | ⚠️ Old |
15: 
16: This README covers the **Modern version**. For the legacy PHP version, see [legacy-php/](legacy-php/).
17: 
18: ---
19: 
20: ## 🚀 Features
21: 
22: ### 👑 Admin Dashboard
23: - System overview with comprehensive statistics
24: - User management (CRUD for Teachers/Students)
25: - Course management and oversight
26: - Audit log for system activity tracking
27: 
28: ### 👨‍🏫 Teacher Dashboard
29: - Create and manage courses with unique join codes
30: - **Time-sensitive attendance sessions** with unique codes
31: - Real-time attendance tracking
32: - Student enrollment management
33: - Attendance reports and export
34: - Upload course materials
35: - Grade assignment submissions
36: 
37: ### 🧑‍🎓 Student Dashboard
38: - Join courses using class codes
39: - Submit attendance with time-sensitive codes
40: - View personal attendance records
41: - Track attendance rate per course
42: - Download course materials
43: - Submit assignments
44: 
45: ### 🎯 Core Attendance System
46: - **Unique, time-sensitive codes** (configurable 5-60 minutes)
47: - Real-time countdown timers
48: - Automatic late marking
49: - Anti-fraud measures (one submission per session)
50: - Automatic absent marking when session closes
51: 
52: ### 💬 Messaging
53: - Direct user-to-user messaging
54: - Course-specific discussions
55: - Soft delete for messages
56: 
57: ---
58: 
59: ## 🛠️ Technology Stack
60: 
61: ### Backend
62: | Component | Technology |
63: |-----------|------------|
64: | Framework | Spring Boot 3.2.5 |
65: | Language | Java 17 |
66: | Database | PostgreSQL 17 |
67: | ORM | Hibernate / Spring Data JPA |
68: | Security | Spring Security + JWT |
69: | Migrations | Flyway |
70: | Authentication | JWT (Access + Refresh tokens) |
71: | MFA | TOTP (Google Authenticator) |
72: 
73: ### Frontend
74: | Component | Technology |
75: |-----------|------------|
76: | Framework | React 19 |
77: | Language | TypeScript |
78: | Build Tool | Vite 5 |
79: | Routing | React Router v7 |
80: | HTTP Client | Axios |
81: | Styling | CSS |
82: 
83: ---
84: 
85: ## 📋 Requirements
86: 
87: ### For Modern Version
88: - Java JDK 17+
89: - PostgreSQL 17+
90: - Node.js 20+ (for frontend)
91: - Maven 3.9+ (or use included wrapper)
92: 
93: ### For Legacy Version (Deprecated)
94: - XAMPP (or similar with Apache + PHP + MySQL)
95: - PHP 8.0+
96: - MySQL 5.7+
97: 
98: ---
99: 
100: ## 🛠️ Installation
101: 
102: ### Modern Version (Recommended)
103: 
104: #### 1. Database Setup
105: ```powershell
106: # Install PostgreSQL 17 if not already installed
107: # Create database
108: CREATE DATABASE attendease_db;
109: ```
110: 
111: #### 2. Backend Setup
112: ```powershell
113: cd backend
114: 
115: # Run with Maven wrapper (auto-installs Maven)
116: .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run
117: 
118: # Or with Maven installed
119: mvn spring-boot:run
120: ```
121: 
122: The backend will:
123: - Connect to PostgreSQL at `localhost:5432/attendease_db`
124: - Run Flyway migrations automatically
125: - Seed demo data on first run
126: - Start on http://localhost:8080
127: 
128: #### 3. Frontend Setup
129: ```powershell
130: cd frontend
131: 
132: # Install dependencies
133: npm install
134: 
135: # Start development server
136: npm run dev
137: ```
138: 
139: The frontend will start on http://localhost:5173
140:

144: 
145: #### 1. Place in XAMPP htdocs
146: ```
147: C:\xampp\htdocs\Attendance-management-system\
148: ```
149: 
150: #### 2. Create Database
